create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to track running average and current value of training metrics
create_RunningAverageMeter: create a RunningAverageMeter with configurable momentum to smooth metric values over time
use_get_logger: use get_logger to set up a file and console logger with optional debug mode
use_save_checkpoint: use save_checkpoint to save PyTorch model state with automatic old checkpoint cleanup
use_ExponentialMovingAverage: use ExponentialMovingAverage to maintain and apply EMA weights to a PyTorch model
